name: paper-reading-suite
description: Read arxiv papers from their TeX source and summarize them in the context of the current project.

interface.shortDescription: Fetch and digest arxiv papers from TeX source.
interface.longDescription: Downloads an arxiv paper's TeX source, reads it from the entrypoint through all relevant files, and writes a summary that connects the paper to the current project. Adapted from the read-arxiv-paper skill in karpathy/nanochat.
defaultPrompt: Read this arxiv paper and summarize it for the current project.
Fetch the TeX source of this paper and digest it.
